description: Five bounded official Cloudflare public-source excerpts for structured extraction quality checks.

cases.source_text: Compliance resources: Explore our posture around ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and others.

expected_response.claim: Cloudflare publicly identifies SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 among its compliance resources.
expected_response.supporting_quote: Explore our posture around ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and others.
expected_response.recommended_action: Request the current in-scope compliance package for the renewal record.

cases.source_text: Certifications and Reports: ISO 27001:2022. SOC 2 Type II.

expected_response.claim: Cloudflare lists ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II in its compliance resources.
expected_response.recommended_action: Obtain the current reports needed for vendor assurance review.

cases.source_text: Data Localization Suite: Enterprise-only paid add-on.

expected_response.claim: Cloudflare identifies Data Localization Suite as an Enterprise-only paid add-on.
expected_response.recommended_action: Confirm whether residency requirements require this add-on in renewal scope.

cases.source_text: Enterprise customers can purchase a dedicated egress IP (IPv4 and IPv6) or range of IPs geolocated to one or more Cloudflare network locations.

expected_response.claim: Cloudflare documents a purchasable dedicated egress IP option for Enterprise customers.
expected_response.supporting_quote: Enterprise customers can purchase a dedicated egress IP
expected_response.recommended_action: Confirm whether dedicated egress addressing is required in commercial scope.

cases.source_text: Increased HTTP 502 Errors in Buenos Aires. This incident has been resolved.

expected_response.claim: Cloudflare status history lists a resolved HTTP 502 error incident in Buenos Aires.
expected_response.supporting_quote: Increased HTTP 502 Errors in Buenos Aires. This incident has been resolved.
expected_response.recommended_action: Check whether the incident affected relevant business traffic or monitoring.
